ideas.children_he: לִיהוּדָה נוֹלְדָה מִשְׁפָּחָה, וְהַסִּפּוּר עוֹבֵר לְחַיָּיו.
ideas.children_en: Judah left his home, married a woman named Bat-Shoah, and they had three sons, including the oldest, Er. He also gave one son a wife named Tamar.

ideas.children_he: תָּמָר נִשְׁאֲרָה אַלְמָנָה וְהִרְגִּישָׁה שֶׁאֵין מִי שֶׁדּוֹאֵג לֶעָתִיד שֶׁלָּהּ.
ideas.children_en: Er was bad and died. Judah told Onan to have children with Tamar for his brother, but Onan refused and died too. Tamar was sent to her father's home to wait for Shelah to grow up.

ideas.children_he: תָּמָר חִפְּשָׂה דֶּרֶךְ לְקַבֵּל אֶת מַה שֶּׁהֻבְטַח לָהּ.
ideas.children_en: After his wife died, Judah left with his friend to find comfort. Tamar, his daughter-in-law, heard he left and hid because she did not want to stay an unmarried widow without children.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה לֹא זִהָה אֶת תָּמָר וְהִשְׁאִיר אֶצְלָהּ חֲפָצִים שֶׁלּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Judah met Tamar but did not know her and thought she was a prostitute. She asked for payment and kept some of his things. They met and she became pregnant by him, then she went back to being a widow so no one would shame her.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁמַּסְתִּירִים אֶת הָאֱמֶת, הַמַּצָּב עָלוּל לְהִסְתַּבֵּךְ.
ideas.children_en: Judah sent his friend to pay and get the pledge back, but no one found Tamar. Judah said she could keep it to avoid shame and stopped looking for her.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה הֵבִין שֶׁטָּעָה וְהוֹדָה בְּאַחֲרָיוּתוֹ. זֶהוּ צַעַד חָשׁוּב לְתִקּוּן.
ideas.children_en: Tamar was sent to be punished for her pregnancy, but she sent Judah his things and showed she was pregnant by him. Judah understood she was right and did not blame her but did not return to her.

ideas.children_he: תָּמָר יוֹלֶדֶת תְּאוֹמִים. זֶרַח מוֹשִׁיט יָד וְנִקְשָׁר עָלֶיהָ חוּט אָדֹם, אֲבָל פֶּרֶץ נוֹלָד לְפָנָיו.
ideas.children_en: Tamar gives birth to twins. Zerah puts out a hand, and a red thread is tied to it, but Perez is born before him.
